protection.access_closed: Chat access is locked. Sign in again.
protection.unavailable: Protected chats could not be opened. Your data has been preserved. Try signing in again.
protection.key_missing: The protected chat key is missing or damaged. Your data has been preserved. No replacement key was created.
protection.initialization_unavailable: Chat protection could not be completed safely. Your data has been preserved. Try signing in again. If the error continues, keep the existing application data for diagnosis.
service.database_in_use: Another Tokenlogue process is using this data folder. Close that process before trying again. Close older versions before updating chat protection.
protection.binding_mismatch: The sign-in data does not match the protected chats. Use device authentication to recover access if it is available.
protection.native_reason: Authenticate with your device to choose a new Tokenlogue PIN.
protection.recovery_unavailable: Device authentication is unavailable. Set up a device PIN, pattern, or password. Your existing app PIN and data have been preserved.
protection.recovery_cancelled: Device authentication was not completed. Your existing PIN and chats have been preserved.
protection.sign_in_first: Sign in with your existing app PIN, then open the ⋮ menu and choose Replace OpenRouter key. If you forgot your PIN, use device recovery when available. A new API key does not unlock existing chats.
protection.replace_key: Enter your new OpenRouter key. Your app PIN and chats will be kept.
